codeFindings.desc: Raw SQL injection vulnerability in multi-attribute search filtering clause.
DOM-based XSS when rendering user-submitted product feedback without sanitization.
Hardcoded test webhook signing secret in production config fallback.
Race condition leading to negative stock counts during flash sale concurrency.
Missing CSRF token verification on vendor bank account change form.
Open redirect on post-login redirect_url query parameter.
SSRF vulnerability when fetching vendor product image URLs from remote servers.
Database schema table names exposed in JSON validation error payload.
God struct: ProductRecord contains 68 attributes and multiple serialization methods.
Unindexed table scan querying millions of vendor order rows.
Magic numbers for cookie expiration and cart idle timeout values.
Individual HTTP calls for document indexing instead of bulk API batching.
Bcrypt cost factor set to 8; recommended minimum is 12.
Prometheus metric exporter served over plain HTTP on internal port 9090.
Dead code: Legacy Authorize.Net payment adapter unused since migration.
Hardcoded sentiment keywords array duplicated across three separate modules.
Blocking SMTP connection inside event subscriber loop.
Customer billing street address and phone number logged in cleartext.
Vendor API token authentication accepts unsigned debug headers in staging/prod.
Deeply nested switch statements for order status transition validation.

vulnerabilities.title: SQL Injection in Catalog Filter Clause
vulnerabilities.desc: Dynamic SQL construction in product filter allows arbitrary database queries.

vulnerabilities.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting in Product Reviews
vulnerabilities.desc: Malicious script tags in review submissions execute in customer browsers.

vulnerabilities.title: Hardcoded Payment Webhook Secret
vulnerabilities.desc: Static secret in payment/stripe_config.go permits webhook forgery.

vulnerabilities.title: Inventory Stock Deduction Race Condition
vulnerabilities.desc: Concurrent orders can oversell physical inventory beyond warehouse capacity.

vulnerabilities.title: Cleartext PII in Checkout Audit Logs
vulnerabilities.desc: Customer phone numbers and shipping addresses written unencrypted to log files.

vulnerabilities.title: Unsigned Debug Token Bypass in Vendor API
vulnerabilities.desc: Header X-Debug-Vendor-Bypass allows unauthenticated vendor store access.

vulnerabilities.title: CSRF on Vendor Bank Settings Form
vulnerabilities.desc: Payout destination can be hijacked via forged request from attacker domain.

vulnerabilities.title: Server-Side Request Forgery in Image Importer
vulnerabilities.desc: Remote image fetch accepts private subnet addresses (10.0.0.0/8, 127.0.0.1).

vulnerabilities.title: Open Redirect in Post-Login Handler
vulnerabilities.desc: Attacker can redirect authenticated buyers to credential phishing sites.

vulnerabilities.title: Internal Error Stack Trace Leaked in JSON
vulnerabilities.desc: PostgreSQL constraint error names returned directly to unauthenticated clients.
